name: TB-the-old-band-in-straight-lines
old: const round = maxNear(carriageway, g.W, g.H, FABRIC.kerb);   // the carriageway and its ring, by the eight ways
new: const round = Float32Array.from(carriageway, (v, i) => (v || paths.some((p) => p.some((q) => Math.hypot((q % g.W) - (i % g.W), Math.floor(q / g.W) - Math.floor(i / g.W)) <= 3.5)) ? 1 : 0));

name: TB-the-ring-by-four-ways
old: const round = maxNear(carriageway, g.W, g.H, FABRIC.kerb);   // the carriageway and its ring, by the eight ways
new: const round = Uint8Array.from(carriageway, (v, i) => (v || carriageway[i - 1] || carriageway[i + 1] || carriageway[i - g.W] || carriageway[i + g.W] ? 1 : 0));
